analyst_view.overall: Early view: Real Madrid host PSV in the Champions League on Tuesday before this Saturday night game, so Mourinho may rotate, but his side has won eight in a row with Vinícius back from suspension. Alavés, winless in eight under Quique Sánchez Flores, lost 6-1 at Barcelona but then defended deep for a 0-0 at Sevilla; one injury list has Facundo Garcés and Mikel Rodríguez out with cruciate injuries.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals. Alavés lost 6-1 at Barcelona last month, their defence is missing Garcés, and Madrid scored three at Mestalla while hardly being tested. Even with some rotation after PSV, I lean towards four goals rather than two.

corners.text: The site expects 9.3 corners. Alavés defend in a deep 3-5-2, so Madrid will spend long spells around the box, which pushes up their corner count even though Mourinho's sides prefer quick attacks. Ten looks fair.

cards.text: The model has 4.5 cards. Sánchez Flores' side committed 19 fouls and took three yellows at Sevilla, and a team defending deep against Mbappé and Vinícius usually commits fouls to stop counterattacks. Five cards is my call.

shots.text: The site expects 28.2 shots and I agree. Madrid had 19 at Valencia, and Alavés managed nine at Sevilla, so the total should be near the site's figure.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.5 on target. Madrid were efficient at Mestalla and their front line is complete again, but some rotation after PSV keeps me at the site's figure rather than above it.
